domain: Constraint Archaeology methodology control - factory/modular housing construction
t0_date: ~2017-2018 (Katerra-era modular-housing capital wave; exact freeze point not separately stated in this document the way 03/04/05b state theirs)
t1_date: ~2021-2023 (Katerra bankruptcy 2021; Ilke Homes and Legal & General's modular arm wound down 2022-2023, cited in the document's own reveal section)
core_proposition: Does factory/modular housing construction (replacing skilled on-site labor with factory capital) pass Constraint Archaeology's structural test for a real, exploitable mechanism shift, as judged from information available before the outcome was known?
t0_evidence_artifact_ids: docs/method/controls/02-negative-control-modular-housing.md Parts 1-4 (15-process rubric walkthrough + forced verdict, sections framed as pre-reveal)
t1_outcome_artifact_ids: docs/method/controls/02-negative-control-modular-housing.md Part 6 ("What we learned about the method") citing Katerra, Ilke, and L&G by name as real failures
outcome_rationale: The document's own "forced verdict" section title and closing lesson ("the single most useful check in this whole analysis is: does the proposal replace an elastic cost with an inelastic one, against cyclical demand? - this single question alone kills modular construction, Katerra, Ilke, and L&G") frame this as a case where a forced/naive PASS would have been wrong; the real-world outcome was failure.
why_outcome_is_externally_grounded: Katerra's 2021 bankruptcy, Ilke Homes' 2023 collapse, and Legal & General's 2023 modular-housing wind-down are real, independently reported corporate events, not another model's opinion.
known_leakage_risks: SEVERE, not ruled out. (1) This is an extensively publicly covered set of failures (Katerra alone raised >$2B from SoftBank and its bankruptcy was widely covered in construction/tech/VC press) that a frontier model trained through ~2024-2025 has a high prior probability of already knowing, independent of anything in a redacted T0 packet - the task requires this NOT be assumed absent from training data, and here it cannot be. (2) The source document itself is a completed, already-reasoned 15-field structured analysis with its own recorded verdict ('PASS WITH NARROW WEDGE' per its own Part 4) - using any extract of it as 'T0 evidence' would hand the experimental models a prior analyst's finished conclusions to grade, not raw facts to independently interpret, which is a second, independent validity failure distinct from training-data contamination.
exclusion_reason: Fails the implicit strengthening of criterion C ('models must receive only the frozen T0 packet' cannot be honestly claimed to exclude training-data memorization of a famous, extensively covered failure) and independently fails on evidence-purity grounds (source document already contains a finished prior analysis, not raw T0 facts).

core_proposition: Does an entrant-controlled, two-terminal intracoastal container-shipping scheme pass Constraint Archaeology's structural test for a real, exploitable mechanism shift, as judged from information available in 1955?
t0_evidence_artifact_ids: docs/method/controls/03-positive-control-containerization.md Parts 1-11+13 (14-process rubric walkthrough, elasticity/migration/value-capture/incumbent-lock/capability-shift/compounding analysis, pre-registered kill tests, and the frozen interim verdict 'PASS WITH NARROW WEDGE')
t1_outcome_artifact_ids: docs/method/controls/03-positive-control-containerization.md Part 12 (historical reveal: real per-ton cost figures, labor deal dates, standardization timeline, 1969 sale price)
